metadata.disclaimer: Curated public bus timetable and frequency guide for Vaishno Devi pilgrimage corridors. All services operate as public stage carriages or interstate scheduled services. Timings, frequencies, and fares are governed by published STA tariff notifications and counter schedules. Real-time GPS location and dynamic seat reservation are not available.

schedules.route_description: Jammu General Bus Stand to Katra via NH-44 / NH-144 (approx 44 km)
schedules.operating_hours: 05:00 to 22:00 (Regular stage carriage departures based on passenger flow)
schedules.fare_disclaimer: Governed by J&K State Transport Authority Notification No. 01-P-MVD of 2026. Ordinary stage carriage passenger tariff approximately ₹75 to ₹110 based on vehicle category and highway toll. Purchase tickets directly at General Bus Stand counter.
